description: Inline-image case 8: 156x204 portrait photo JPEG in the signature (288 bytes), inline, cid-referenced -> possible KYC (B.6: short side 156 > 150; long side 204 and bytes are within limits). Investor raises his Solent commitment to EUR 40,000 -> commitment_change_ack.
notes: Attachment 0 (pieter-van-dijk.jpg) meets a-e and fails f on the short side only (156 > 150), so a face photo is not exempt. Commitment via the sender's single investor_id (C-LNK-2); authenticated with his own key, so commitment_change_ack (discloses_record) is allowed. Only one amount in the email. No bank line by reference SB-005 and the email has no payment date, so transaction_ids is empty (T-SB-0005 has reference SUBSCRIPTION).
